ai.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 launch
ai.description: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5, a Mythos-class model generally available June 9, 2026, with state-of-the-art results across software engineering, vision, scientific research and knowledge work.

ai.title: OpenAI model disproves 80-year-old geometry conjecture
ai.description: OpenAI reported that one of its models solved the unit distance problem in discrete geometry, overturning a conjecture that had stood for roughly 80 years.

ai.title: Google DeepMind highlights Gemini 3.5 Live Translate and Gemma 4 12B
ai.description: Google DeepMind's June 2026 model updates include fluid voice translation and Gemma 4 12B, a unified encoder-free multimodal model for responsible AI applications.

ai.title: arXiv benchmark evaluates frontier LLM research agents
ai.description: The June 5, 2026 paper 'Act As a Real Researcher' introduces a benchmark suite for evaluating frontier LLMs and agentic harnesses across the research lifecycle.

funding.title: Anthropic files to go public after $65B raise
funding.description: TechCrunch reported Anthropic's confidential IPO filing on June 1, 2026, less than a week after a $65B Series H round that pushed the company to a $965B post-money valuation.

funding.title: Cognition raises $1B at $25B pre-money valuation
funding.description: The Devin maker raised more than $1B, reaching a $25B pre-money valuation and $26B post-money valuation as autonomous software engineering capital keeps compounding.

funding.title: Coralogix raises $200M for AI-agent monitoring
funding.description: Coralogix raised $200M in a round that valued the observability startup at $1.6B post-money, positioning it as a monitoring layer for AI agents.

funding.title: Sandstone raises $30M for AI legal teams
funding.description: Sandstone announced a $30M Series A on June 9, 2026 to bring AI tools to in-house legal teams and automate legal workflow discovery.

tools.title: GitHub Copilot SDK becomes generally available
tools.description: GitHub made Copilot SDK generally available on June 2, 2026, letting teams embed Copilot's agentic engine into apps, services and developer tools through a stable API.

tools.title: GitHub Copilot app expands to all Copilot tiers
tools.description: GitHub expanded technical preview availability for its agent-native Copilot app across Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business and Enterprise customers on June 2, 2026.

tools.title: Vercel AI SDK 6 adds reusable agents
tools.description: Vercel's AI SDK 6 introduces an Agent abstraction for reusable agents with model, instructions and tools, plus type-safe UI streaming and structured outputs.

tools.title: Microsoft Build 2026 ships open trust stack for agents
tools.description: Microsoft highlighted open evaluations, portable runtime controls, production observability and security workflows for building trustworthy AI agents across frameworks.

industry.title: EU targets Big Tech dependence with made-in-Europe drive
industry.description: Reuters reported that the European Commission proposed laws on June 3, 2026 to boost domestic cloud, AI and semiconductor industries while reducing reliance on U.S. Big Tech.

industry.title: U.S. House draft would block state AI regulation
industry.description: Reuters reported on June 4, 2026 that bipartisan U.S. House lawmakers released draft legislation to prohibit states from regulating AI development and deployment.

industry.title: AI leaders call for protections against AI-aided bioweapons
industry.description: The Verge reported that AI leaders sent an open letter to U.S. lawmakers pressing for rules to close biosecurity gaps from AI-assisted biological weapons work.

industry.title: Seattle weighs data-center moratorium as Amazon employees ask for brakes
industry.description: The Verge reported that Seattle's city council is considering a one-year moratorium on new data centers after Amazon employees asked officials to slow AI infrastructure growth.

oss.title: Cohere releases North Mini Code on Hugging Face
oss.description: Cohere Labs released North Mini Code on June 9, 2026: a 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters under Apache 2.0 for agentic coding.

oss.title: Google introduces Gemini CLI open-source AI agent
oss.description: Google announced Gemini CLI on June 4, 2026 as an open-source AI agent that brings Gemini capabilities directly into the terminal for developers.

oss.title: Gemma 4 12B joins the open-source ecosystem
oss.description: Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 12B is positioned as a unified, encoder-free multimodal model with open ecosystem integrations for on-device and cloud AI apps.

oss.title: Ollama 0.30 improves local model performance
oss.description: Ollama 0.30 shipped June 5, 2026 with improved performance and GGUF model compatibility through llama.cpp for faster local inference workflows.
